methods.label: Find the total seconds, then convert
methods.explanation:
Each of the \(300\) dimples takes \(2\) seconds, so the total painting time is
\[
300\cdot2=600\text{ seconds}.
\]
Since one minute contains \(60\) seconds, this is
\[
600\div60=\boxed{10\text{ minutes}},
\]
choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
methods.levelReason: This uses whole-number multiplication and the elementary conversion from seconds to minutes.
